label: run143 KEEPER net-load outage filter
definition: KEEPER (supersedes run142). Same two grounded fixes as run142 — the CAMPD revealed-availability outage filter (drop economic-idle false outages that the CF<5% rule flagged in low-demand months, the source of the 2024/25 co-opt over-fire) + the ST_GAS committed-offer restore — but the filter now keys on EXOGENOUS NET LOAD (EIA-930 demand-wind-solar) instead of raw load, to also catch winter-storm/VRE-drought tightness below the summer raw-load peak. Result: 2023 36.5/MAE 12.0/tail 104-56; 2024 23.2/MAE 9.6/22-16; 2025 31.4/MAE 2.9/1-0 vs actual 48.4(181/104)/26.8(53/16)/32.5(31/3). Mean MAE 8.2 (run139 keeper was 10.6). Over-fire fixed (Oct-2024 $73.7/17h -> $32.3/3h) with real summer scarcity preserved (Aug max $5000). FINDING: net-load == load-p85 (run142, mean MAE 7.7) within noise; net load did NOT recover the 2024-Jan winter storm ($22/3h vs actual $44/19h) — winter-storm scarcity is a separate extreme-weather/out-of-market problem, like 2023's ~42% out-of-market tail (run140), not an outage-filter lever. KNOWN: tails still thin (under actual scarcity-hour counts); 2023 structurally under. GATED: ERCOT outage CSVs regenerated on net-load; OTHER ISOs share the rule and need re-gating by their owners.
